assets.name: Frame_Damage
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the approved 01 Noble Diamond reference; use the three LARGE frames in its upper half, not the sample below. Deliver a faithful reconstruction/extraction of ONLY ONE diamond FRAME as a transparent production Unity UI sprite. This is not a redesign. Geometry: exact 45-degree square diamond, four identical modest faceted ivory/antique-gold diamond joints centered on its north/east/south/west tips. Joints around 13 percent of the overall diamond diameter. Two parallel colored rails with a slender near-black gap between them, each rail bright on one edge, about 2 percent overall diameter for combined rim. The rails must read primarily as their category color NOT as gold; gold is limited to four tip jewels. Crisp restrained pixel-art stepped edges, clear coherent strokes, no scratch noise, no sparkling jagged speckles. Centered square canvas 1024 with outermost tips (512,64),(960,512),(512,960),(64,512). Perfect left/right geometry and balanced tips. NO icons, no cooldown ring, no ticks, no velvet, no center fill. Real alpha transparent INSIDE and OUTSIDE frame, no checkerboard. No words or numbers. No black background rectangle. Preserve reference proportions and the slim noble double rails, not bulky jewelry. Reconstruct the left flame slot FRAME: antique muted ruby/crimson red rails, cream joint highlights. Long diagonals use red not gold. Deep red sidewall, warm red thin highlight like reference.
